lead_raw_text:
The structure of Tb28Cd10 (reduced formula Tb14Cd5) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with 38 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cd centers coordinated by 12 Tb neighbors and Tb centers with 14 geometric neighbors (8 Cd, 6 Tb), while Tb–Tb distances range from 3.71 to 3.84 Å. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 38 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner- and edge-sharing between Cd-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Tb-centered 14-vertex polyhedra.
